demo.title: Try the payment dispute flow
demo.description: A development-only demo assignment simulates a PHP 500 payment dispute for a five-day job where three days were completed. It uses synthetic reserved funds and dedicated test accounts.
demo.stepWorker: Sign in with the demo worker account and open a payment dispute from Applied Jobs.
demo.stepEmployer: Sign in with the demo employer account to verify the dispute notice and payment hold.
demo.stepAdmin: Return here as finance admin to investigate and resolve the case with a worker payment from PHP 0 to PHP 500.
demo.seedHint: Prepare or restart locally: set ENABLE_PAYMENT_DISPUTE_DEMO_SEED=true and PAYMENT_DISPUTE_DEMO_PASSWORD in server/.env, then run npm --prefix server run seed:payment-dispute-demo. The command prints the test account emails.
